newsitem.title: CANADA: IPSCO to issue C$100 mln in debentures.
newsitem.headline: IPSCO to issue C$100 mln in debentures.

text.p: IPSCO Inc on Monday said it agreed to issue C$100 million of 7.8 percent debentures due December 1, 2006.

The Regina, Saskatchewan-based steel producer said the debentures were sold on a bought deal basis to a syndicate of underwriters consisting of Nesbitt Burns Inc as lead, TD Securities Inc and RBC Dominion Securities Inc.
IPSCO said it would file a preliminary prospectus today to qualify the debentures for sale in every Canadian province, with the transaction expected to close on October 10.

The company said proceeds from the debt financing would be used for general corporate purposes. They included expenditures relating to the refurbishment of existing facilities, construction of new facilities, strategic acquisitions and other capital expenditures.
